messages:
Alex Chen: Quick design review — posted the new roles grid prototype in Figma (https://www.figma.com/file/xyz). Main concerns: visual scanline noise and keyboard focus jumps when rows expand. Can we do a quick pass?
Maya Patel: Saw the figma — looks promising. Two quick nits: 1) inherited-permission chips have no aria-describedby so screen reader users can't tell why a permission is greyed. 2) Focus order shifts when accordion expands and pushes content down.
Samir Rao: Agree on the focus problem. Suggest roving tabindex on rows and explicit aria-expanded on the toggle button. Example: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="perm-list-123">
Tanya L: Copy tweak: change modal header from "Assign" to "Grant access" — 'Assign' reads like assign an owner. Also SSO toggle placement debate: do we keep it in org header or inline per-role?
Alex Chen: Good call on copy. For SSO: my take — keep a global SSO switch in Org settings + a clearly labeled "SSO exceptions" affordance at role level. That preserves context but avoids per-row noise.
Raghu (Design): Visual suggestions: reduce avatar column density (avatars are stealing scanline), add 4px horizontal padding between role name and chips, and increase hover contrast (current hover is < 2.5:1). That addresses the a11y contrast fail.
Maya Patel: Audit log nav: current flyout makes filtering by role clumsy. Proposal: persistent filter pills above timeline and an accessible shortcut to focus the filter (example: press "g then a" to open Audit). Also add label text for the filter button for screen readers.
Samir Rao: On permission lists — prefer collapsed-by-default with an explicit chevron and aria-controls. Revealing on hover is not keyboard or touch friendly. When expanded, ensure the newly revealed region receives focus or is reachable via arrow keys.
DevexBot: Heads-up: preview build is up at https://staging.redwood.ai/role-grid?preview=scanline-a11y — includes initial keyboard-nav fixes and updated hover contrast.
Alex Chen: Action items: Raghu — update figma with reduced density + padding + hover contrast; Samir — PR to add aria-expanded/controls + roving tabindex pattern; Maya — mock persistent audit filter pill + keyboard shortcut copy; Tanya — update modal copy to "Grant access" and draft microcopy for empty audit state. Can we aim for a limited canary to beta orgs early next week? :thumbsup:
Tanya L: +1. Microcopy for empty audit state suggestion: "No events for the selected role in the last 7 days." Keep it short and avoid jargon.
Alex Chen: Perfect. I'll consolidate and schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow for final sign-off. Thanks everyone!
